subject: Losing individual identifier when converting to telemetry object

messages.author: dbb8469ee2e94d03
messages.subject: Losing individual identifier when converting to telemetry object
parts:
Hi Chris,


A colleague and I are both running into the same issue with respect to our different datasets: when we convert a MoveStack object into a list of telemetry objects, we lose the individual identifier/animal id. Here is example code. We are each working with data imported from a csv file rather than MoveBank.

#Import GPS data with multiple individuals
data <- read.csv('gps_data_all.csv')
data$timestamp <- as.POSIXct(data$timestamp,format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz="UTC")

#Covert to MoveStack
movedata <- move(x=data$longitude, y=data$latitude,
                 time=data$timestamp,
                 data=data, 
                 proj=sp::CRS("+init=epsg:4326"),
                 animal=data$id)

#Test that animal id is retained in MoveStack object
movedata@trackId #shows vector of animal ids
movedata@idData #shows vector of animal ids alongside other attributes from original dataframe

#Convert to list of telemetry objects
telemdata <- as.telemetry(movedata, drop=FALSE, projection="+init=epsg:4326")

#Test that animal id is retained in Telemetry object
telemdata[[1]]@info # $identity "unknown" --> animal ID is lost
#when tested on buffalo data, buffalo[[1]]@info $identity "Cilla"

I tried making the id variable a factor and also character string. Do you see anything obvious that we're missing?

Thanks,
Briana
